mainEntity.name: How much does Spaceship hosting cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Essential is $19.88 for the first year and $28.88 a year at renewal.

mainEntity.name: Is there a Spaceship promo code?

acceptedAnswer.text: Its sale page lists COM67 for a .com at $3.60 for the first year, for new registrations.

mainEntity.name: Does Spaceship have a free trial?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. It lists a 30-day free trial on shared hosting.

mainEntity.name: Does Spaceship have an AI website builder?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. It lists an AI Website Builder, and WordPress AI tools on Pro and Supreme.
